title: Fixed Weighted Two Arm Polar Planimeter
description: One newly authored whole static polar-planimeter instrument appearance. A low heavy round pole weight supports an upright joint and one long pole arm. A second whole angled tracing arm joins it at a headed pin and ends in an open tracing-eye surround with a short blunt central tip and upper finger grip. A distinct measuring-wheel head straddles the tracing arm: two side cheeks, an actual open interval around the finite wheel, an axle, and a separate blank readout disk. One complete connected tool, no drawing board, paper, drawings or second model. No old four-bar pantograph or drawing-compass arms imported. Four constant opaque PBR materials. No motion, accurate area measurement, integration ratio, calibration, scale reading, drawing, marking, scientific performance, manufacture or handling safety claim.
